scope: Host overlay policy/admission component; these tests do not prove integrated legacy spool/inline enforcement or full FUSE snapshot correctness.

aggregate_defaults.existing_scheduler_domains: Live128MiB and transfer32MiB semaphores reused; overlay aggregate memory counts additional transfer reservations once.

accounting: Disk reservations guarantee bounded quotas across Workspaces; they are not actual disk use/RSS. Actual data/catalog/spool occupancy remains in component Stats. Bounded resident owner tables/page working sets and replay capacity reserve live permits; additional owned request/cursor/journal buffers use scoped live/transfer permits. Scratch/file permits must remain with resources until those resources close.
lifetime: Payload Inner holds Budget keepalive as its last field; independent OwnedRange, physical reader and metadata Index Root all retain it. Budget contains no Payload/Index resource, avoiding a cycle. Aggregate disk/FD/fixed resident charges release after the last backing owner closes.
compatibility: Original max_spool_bytes/max_final_delta_memory_bytes fields and checks unchanged. ResourcePolicy remote seed still consumes exactly two u64 values; new host-only overlay field uses Default locally. Existing1TiB maximum file result,8193pieces and4096-byte symlink limit are retained.
reused_passes: Existing legacy spool/final-delta boundary checks remain unchanged; not rerun. Payload operations are unchanged except optional last-field lifetime retention; independent retained-range lifetime is explicitly tested.
remaining: HostOverlay must enforce legacy cumulative spool and inline policies in addition to this physical admission factory; parent/host agent notified.
Wire and SDK integration must retain operation permits with their actual buffers/journals/replies; no benchmark or full surface acceptance asserted.
